# cubepath_floating_ip (Resource)

Manages a floating IP address on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_type` (String) IP type: IPv4 or IPv6.
- `location_name` (String) Location name (e.g., us-mia-1).

### Optional

- `assign_baremetal_id` (Number) Baremetal server ID to assign the floating IP to.
- `assign_vps_id` (Number) VPS ID to assign the floating IP to.
- `reverse_dns` (String) Reverse DNS (PTR record) hostname.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The acquired floating IP address.
- `id` (String) The floating IP address (used as identifier).
- `status` (String) Current status of the floating IP.
